UMUGEREKA WA MBERE
Ingingo rusange zerekeye ibaruramari
1/1 1 Ibipimo by’ibaruramari
1/2 1.1 Kuri buri serivisi ikoreshwa mu
mibanire runaka, Ibihugu bigize
Umuryango bigomba gukora ibishoboka
byose kugira ngo ibigo byemerewe bikora
itumanaho, binyuze mu bwumvikane,
bishyireho kandi bivugurure ibipimo
by'ibaruramari bigomba gukoreshwa
hagati yabyo, hitawe ku byifuzonama bya
ITU-T n’imihindagurikire y’ikiguzi cyo
gutanga serivisi yihariye y’itumanaho.
Ibyo bipimo bigomba kugabanywamo
imigabane yishyurwa ibigo byemerewe
bikora itumanaho mu bihugu itumanaho
rirangiriramo, no mu bihugu itumanaho
rinyuramo iyo ari ngombwa.
1/3 1.2 Byongeye, mu nzira z’’itumanaho
aho ubushakashatsi ku kiguzi cyaITU-T
bushobora gukoreshwa nk’ishingiro,
igipimo cy’ibaruramari gishobora
kugenwa hakurikijwe ubu buryo
bukurikira:
1/4 a) ibigo byemerewe bikora itumanaho
bigomba gushyiraho no kuvugurura
imigabane yabyo yishyurwa ibigo bikorera
ibijyanye n’itumanaho mu gihugu
itumanaho ryoherezwamo n’ibyo
itumanaho rinyuramo hashingiwe ku
byifuzonama bya ITU-T.
1/5 b) igipimo cy’ibaruramari kizaba
igiteranyo cy’imigabane yishyurwa ibigo
bikora itumanaho mu gihugu rirangiriramo
n’icyo rinyuramo.
1/6 1.3 Iyo ikigo kimwe cyangwa byinshi
byemerewe bikora itumanaho bibona,
binyuze mu mafaranga ahoraho yishyurwa
cyangwa andi masezerano, uburenganzira
bwo gukoresha igice cy’umuyoboro
na/cyangwa ibikoresho by’ibindi bigo
byemerewe bikora itumanaho, bifite
uburenganzira bwo gushyiraho imigabane
yabyo ivugwa muri nimero 1/2 (1.1) na 1/3
(1.2) ziri haruguru, ku gice cy’inzira
runaka.
1/7 1.4 Mu gihe inzira imwe cyangwa
nyinshi mpuzamahanga zashyizweho
binyuze mu masezerano hagati y'ibigo
byemerewe bikora itumanaho kandi aho
ikigo cyemerewe gikora ibijyanye
n’itumanaho cyo mu gihugu itumanaho
riturukamo gihindura inzira y’amakuru nta
bwumvikane kigakoresha inzira
mpuzamahanga itumvikanyweho,
amafaranga yishyurwa ikigo cyemerewe
gikora ibijyanye n’itumanaho azaba
angana n’ayo cyari guhabwa iyo
ubwikorezi bwari kunyuzwa mu nzira
yemejwe mbere, kandi ikiguzi cyo
kohereza kizishyurwa n’ikigo cyemerewe
gikora ubwikorezi cyo mu gihugu
itumanaho riturukamo, keretse iyo ikigo
cyemerewe gikora ibijyanye n’itumanaho
ryo mu gihugu itumanaho ryoherejwemo
cyiteguye kumvikana ku yindi migabane
y’amafaranga yishyurwa.
1/8 1.5 Mu gihe itumanaho rinyuzwa
ahantu hadatanzwe uburenganzira
cyangwa nta masezerano ku mugabane
w’amafaranga yishyurwa, ikigo
cyemerewe gikora ibijyanye no kohereza
itumanaho gifite uburenganzira bwo
kugena urugero rw’amafaranga yo
gutambutsa itumanaho y’umugabane
ugomba kwishyurwa ku rwego
mpuzamahanga.
1/9 1.6 Iyo ikigo cyemerewe gikora
itumanaho gicibwa amahoro cyangwa
umusoro ku ibarura ry’igiciro cyangwa ku
yandi mafaranga cyishyurwa, ntikigomba
na cyo gusaba ko ayo mahoro cyangwa
umusoro acibwa ibindi bigo byemerewe
bikora itumanaho.
1/10 2 Ishyirwaho ry’amafaranga
yishyurwa
1/11 2.1 Uretse habayeho ubundi
bwumvikane, ibigo byemerewe bishinzwe
kwakira amafaranga yishyurwa bigomba
gushyiraho imibare y’ibaruramari ya buri
kwezi igaragaza amafaranga yose agomba
kwishyurwa, maze bikayohereza ku bigo
byemerewe birebwa n’iyo mibare.
1/12 2.2 Amafaranga yishyurwa agomba
koherezwa mu buryo bwihuse bushoboka,
hagendewe ku byifuzonama bya ITU-T
bijyanye, kandi usibye mu gihe cy’inzitizi
itigobotorwa, mbere y'uko iminsi 50
irangira ikurikira ukwezi ayo mafaranga
agomba kwishyurwamo, keretse iyo
byemeranyijweho ukundi.
1/13 2.3 Ubusanzwe, amafaranga agomba
kwishyurwa afatwa nk’ayemejwe
bidasabye ko habaho imenyesha ryihariye
ikigo cyemerewe cyohereza rigaragaza ko
kiyemeye.
1/14 2.4 Icyakora, ikigo icyo ari cyo cyose
cyemerewe gikora itumanaho gifite
uburenganzira bwo kugenzura ibikubiye
muri raporo y’amafaranga yishyurwa mu
gihe kitarenze amezi abiri nyuma yo
kuyakira, ariko kikabikora gusa mu rugero
rukenewe kugira ngo impinduka
zigaragazwe bitarenze igihe cyemejwe.
1/15 2.5 Mu gihe nzira zidafite
amasezerano yihariye azigenga, inyandiko
y’imari ya buri gihembwe igaragaza
amafaranga ya buri kwezi asigaye
kwishyurwa mu gihe agomba
kwishyurwamo itegurwa kandi igatangwa
vuba bishoboka n’ikigo cyemerewe gikora
ibijyanye n’itumanaho kiberewemo
umwenda, ikohererezwa ikigo cyemerewe
kigomba kwishyura, nyuma yo
kuyisuzuma, kikagarura kopi cyashyizeho
umukono kigaragaza ko cyemera iyo
mibare.
1/16 2.6 Mu nzira ziziguye aho ikigo
cyemerewe gishinzwe ibyo kohereza
amakuru gikora nk'umuhuza w'ibaruramari
hagati y'utundi duce tubiri tw'itumanaho
ryoherezwamo, ibihugu bigize Umuryango
bigomba guharanira ko ibigo byemerewe
bishyira amakuru y'ibaruramari mu
itumanaho ryohererezwa ibigo byemerewe
bikagira uruhare mu iyoherezwa
ry’itumanaho vuba bishoboka nyuma yo
kwakira ayo makuru avuye ku kigo
cyemerewe giturukamo itumanaho,
hakurikijwe ibyifuzonama bikwiye bya
ITU-T.
1/17 3 Kwishyura amafaranga asigaye
kwishyurwa
1/18 3.1 Guhitamo ifaranga ryishyurwamo
1/19 3.1.1 Kwishyura amafaranga asigaye
kwishyurwa ku rwego rw’itumanaho
mpuzamahanga bikorwa mu ifaranga
ryatoranyijwe n’uwagurijwe, nyuma yo
kugisha inama umubereyemo umwenda.
Mu gihe habaye ukutumvikana,
amahitamo y’uberewemo umwenda
ahabwa agaciro muri byose, hashingiwe ku
biteganyijwe muri N° 1/20 (3.1.2) iri
hepfo. Iyo uberewemo umwenda
atagaragaza ifaranga, amahitamo aba
ay’umubereyemo umwenda.
1/20 3.1.2. Iyo uberewemo umwenda
ahisemo ifaranga rifite agaciro kemejwe
n’uruhande rumwe gusa cyangwa ifaranga
agaciro karyo kagomba kugenwa
hakurikijwe isano yako n’ifaranga rifite
agaciro kashyizweho n’uruhande rumwe
gusa, gukoresha ifaranga ryatoranyijwe
bigomba kwemerwa n'ubereyemo
umwenda abandi.
1/21 3.1.3 Mu gihe igihe cyo kwishyura
cyubahirijwe, ibigo byemerewe bikora
itumanaho bifite uburenganzira, ku
bwumvikane bw'impande zombi, bwo
kwishyura amafaranga bisigaje kwishyura
y’uburyo butandukanye binyuze mu
bikorwa bitandukanye byo kwishyura
amafaranga asigaye kwishyurwa:
1/22 a) inguzanyo n’amafaranga
yishyurwa mu mibanire yabyo n’ibindi
bigo byemewe bikora ibijyanye
n’ikoranabuhanga;
1/23 b) ubundi buryo ubwo ari bwo bwose
bwo kwishyura bwumvikanyweho, iyo ari
ngombwa.
1/24 Iri tegeko rikurikizwa kandi mu gihe
ubwishyu butangwa binyuze mu bigo
byihariye byishyura hakurikijwe
amasezerano y’ibigo byemerewe bikora
ibijyanye n’itumanaho.
1/25 3.2 Kugena umubare w'amafaranga
yishyurwa
1/26 3.2.1 Umubare w'amafaranga
yishyurwa mu ifaranga ryatoranyijwe,
nk'uko bigaragazwa hepfo, ugomba
kungana n'amafaranga asigaye
kwishyurwa.
1/27 3.2.2. Iyo amafaranga asigaye
kwishyurwa agaragajwe mu rugero fatizo
rw’ifaranga ry’Ikigega Mpuzamahanga
cy’Imari (IMF), umubare w’ifaranga
ryatoranyijwe ugenwa hakurikijwe
umubano wariho ku munsi ubanziriza
ubwishyu, cyangwa umubano wa vuba aha
watangajwe n’Ikigega Mpuzamahanga
cy’Imari (IMF), hagati y’urwo rugero
fatizo rw’Ikigega Mpuzamahanga
n’ifaranga ryatoranyijwe.
1/28 3.2.3. Icyakora, iyo isano y’urugero
fatizo rw’Ikigega Mpuzamahanga cy'Imari
(IMF) n’ifaranga ryatoranyijwe
itatangajwe, amafaranga asigaye, ku
ikubitiro, avunjwa mu ifaranga isano yaryo
yatangajwe n’Ikigega, IMF, hakoreshejwe
isano yari iriho umunsi umwe mbere yo
kwishyura cyangwa isano iheruka
gutangazwa. Ingano y’amafaranga
abonetse muri ubwo buryo, ku cyiciro cya
kabiri, avunjwa mu gaciro kangana
n’ak’ifaranga ryatoranyijwe, hakoreshejwe
agaciro k’ivunja kariho mbere y’umunsi
umwe mbere wo kwishyura cyangwa
igipimo giheruka gutangazwa ku isoko
ryemewe ry’ivunjisha rigenzurwa na Leta
cyangwa isoko ryemewe ritagenzurwa na
Leta by’igihugu gifite umwenda.
1/29 3.2.4 Iyo, hakurikijwe amasezerano
